critical_code_review_comments: Fix 1 shield exemption is surgical and correct: shield's third $or clause is `{'id': {'$in': list(seen_ids)}} if seen_ids else {'_id_': 'never'}` — the 'never' sentinel is a nice defensive fallback so an empty seen_ids can't yield an unbounded exemption. Verified at pick_refresh_orchestrator.py:1505-1511.

The two id-scoped `delete_many({'id': {'$in': list(seen_ids)}, ...})` calls at 1530-1533 and 1564-1569 are correctly shield-free — direct id-narrowing already scopes the blast radius so the shield would only cause the very rows being replaced to survive stale.

Fix 2 route wiring is clean: canonical map covers NFL/MLB/NBA/NHL/CFB/WNBA/ncaaf→CFB alias/Soccer/Tennis/UFC; unknown value → HTTPException(400, {error: 'invalid_sport_filter'}) at admin_routes.py:815-822; lease namespaced via f'picks_refresh_today:{_sf_norm}' at 833-834; sport_filter threaded through _refresh_picks at 913 and echoed back in response body at 945.

One tiny observation on admin_routes.py:939-941: existing_count is computed with sport filter applied only when _sf_norm is set — correct behavior. Response body always includes sport_filter key (None when unscoped), so client can rely on presence.
